'''Keshid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. He took part in an operation to kidnap holovid star [[Janissa Locrin]], following [[Seland' Ir]]'s scheme.<ref name="GG11" />
